Following the earnings release, PepsiCo shares rose nearly 1% in premarket trading, reflecting investors’ positive reaction to the stronger-than-expected results.

Snack and beverage giant PepsiCo, Inc. reported Thursday significantly higher profit for its second quarter mainly on sharply lower impairment charges, as well as increased net revenues and volume.
